business_profile.business_overview: Enhance English BD is a British Council and Pearson certified IELTS & PTE training institute with 3 centers (Dhanmondi 27, Banani 11, Chattogram). They've trained 5,000+ students with 10+ certified instructors, achieving 700+ IELTS successes and 650+ PTE successes. They offer Essential, Premium, and Online tiers, plus Speaking & Presentation and Writing & Grammar courses. Their intake is a registration form with course selection, center preference, and class medium (in-person/online). High enquiry volume across 3 centers with form-based intake and no instant AI qualification.
business_profile.offer_surface: Autonomous AI agent deployment for IELTS/PTE coaching institute — targeting: Instant admission enquiry response with course recommendation based on student's target score and timeline; Batch schedule visibility and seat availability agent; Free trial class booking with automated reminders; Multi-center routing ensuring students get info for their nearest branch; Lead nurturing from enquiry to enrollment with follow-up sequences

business_profile.competitive_position: Enhance English competes with MIE English Academy, Mentors', Saifur's, British Council, and many IELTS centers in Dhaka. Their edge is British Council + Pearson certification and strong success numbers. But the IELTS market is crowded and students message several institutes at once. The one that responds instantly, recommends the right course, and books a free trial first wins the enrollment. Without an AI admission agent, Enhance loses the speed race.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With 5,000+ students trained and 3 centers, enrolment volume is significant and each course is a meaningful fee. If form-based intake and manual routing lose even a fraction of enquiries to faster-responding competitors — especially during admission peaks — that's substantial lost enrolment revenue. An AI admission agent that responds instantly, recommends courses, and books trials recovers this and fills batches faster.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI admission agent that answers every enquiry instantly, asks target score + timeline, and recommends the right course tier.
2. Batch schedule + seat availability agent showing upcoming batches per center.
3. Free trial booking agent with automated reminders.
4. Multi-center routing + lead nurturing that follows up enquirers with success stories until they enroll.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A student aiming for IELTS 7.5 messages Enhance English at 9pm: 'I need 7.5 for Canada PR in 4 months. Which course?' The AI replies instantly: 'For 7.5 in 4 months, our Premium tier with weekly mock tests fits. Nearest center: Dhanmondi 27 — next batch starts [date], 3 seats left. Want a free trial class this week?' The student books the trial. Enhance converted an enquiry into a trial booking overnight, with zero staff effort.
